reply: Thank you for explaining that a wage execution was filed using an address that is not yours, so you never received the notice, while other letters reached your correct address. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for copies of the notices and the address they were sent to, and keep proof of your correct address. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two medical collections of $520.00 and $1,100.00 appear on your credit report and that you dispute both the debts and who is listed as the creditor. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Special rules apply to how medical debt is collected and reported, so please dispute both entries with the credit reporting companies and ask the collector for an itemized bill. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid the debt in full but have not received written confirmation, and that the lien remains on your property. We understand how frustrating the conflicting answers have been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team, including the lien release. Please keep proof of your payment and ask in writing for a paid-in-full letter and the steps and timeline for releasing the lien. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collection account appeared on your report without notice and that you did not have a chance to dispute it. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written dispute and ask for the validation information about the debt, including the original creditor and amount, and keep proof of mailing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want certain entries removed from your consumer report because you did not authorize them. We understand your concern about accuracy and privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please list each entry and explain why it is not yours or is inaccurate, and include any documents that support this. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector keeps contacting you about your daughter's medical bills even though she is covered by two insurance plans. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the provider your insurance details in writing and ask it to bill both plans, and keep copies. Collectors generally cannot call at inconvenient times, so note any such calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged over $3,400.00 for a period after you moved out, that the eviction was dismissed, and that the debt is now reported by a collector. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for an itemized statement, and keep your notice to vacate, move-out evidence and the dismissal order. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a debt validation request by certified mail and have not received any of the information you asked for. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the tracking record and a copy of your letter. If you do not believe you owe the debt, keep disputing it in writing and do not ignore further contact. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collection account appears on your report without notice, so you could not dispute it. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written request for the validation information about the debt, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies, keeping proof of mailing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your debt validation request and the documents you have asked for. We understand you do not recognize the debt. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your letter and the date it was sent. Collectors must give you basic information about the debt, such as the creditor and amount, which helps you decide whether it is yours. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you do not recall any relationship with this collection company and want proof that the account belongs on your report. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written dispute, ideally within 30 days of its first notice, and ask for the validation information. Keep copies of your letters and any replies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you left a lease because you felt unsafe, that a $6,000.00 debt is now being collected, and that you are receiving frequent calls from unidentified numbers. We are sorry for what you went through. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Before agreeing to any plan, confirm in writing that you owe the debt and the amount. You can also ask the collector in writing to limit or stop calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute an account you never signed for, and that you believe the collectors used abusive language and did not note your dispute. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep good records of every communication, including letters and call dates, and include copies of your dispute letters with the review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debt collector you have never dealt with is reporting an account on your credit file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Collectors often buy accounts from original creditors, so ask in writing for the original creditor's name and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies if you do not recognize it. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $700.00 debt is being reported after you disputed it and asked for validation, and that your information was exposed in data breaches. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep copies of your dispute and validation request, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies so it is shown as disputed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $730.00 medical bill you do not recognize was sent to collection without an itemized bill, while you had insurance at the time. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the provider for an itemized bill and confirm whether it was sent to your insurer, and dispute the debt in writing with the collector. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your formal dispute and validation request for a debt you do not recall owing. We understand you are not refusing to pay, only asking for proof. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your letter and the date it was sent. Collectors must give you key details about the debt, which help you check whether it is yours. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were billed $85.00 and sent to collection for a chargeback fee after the $75.00 application fee the apartment agreed to return never arrived. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep any message where management agreed to return the fee and your bank's chargeback records, and dispute the debt in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a dispute comment you asked to remove is still on your report, and that you learned of a judgment you were never notified about. We understand how this affects your applications. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the confirmation of your request through the portal, and ask the collector in writing for copies of the court records behind the judgment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your identity was stolen and used to create negative accounts on your credit, and that you have a police report. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please report the theft through the federal identity theft website, close any affected accounts, and send your reports to each company listing an account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two medical accounts were re-reported after being closed, and that one was billed to the wrong insurer. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the provider to bill the correct health insurance, and keep a copy of your validation request. You can also dispute both entries with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collector keeps calling and pressuring you about a debt with a misspelled name and details that do not match yours. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written dispute asking for the validation information, and only share the details needed to confirm your identity. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $4,900.00 lease debt is being collected and reported even though your security deposit was never returned or accounted for. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for an itemized statement that shows how the deposit was applied, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your validation request asking for the original creditor, account details and signed agreement. We understand you want the debt confirmed before anything else. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your request and proof of mailing, and continue to dispute in writing if the response does not show the debt is yours. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector contacted your employer about a debt you do not believe is yours, after you asked them to stop. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a record of each contact with your employer, and send the collector a written request to stop contacting your workplace. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector is reporting a late payment on an account that was paid and later refunded, and that each company refers you to the other. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute with your payment and refund records, and ask who currently owns the account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collector calls you very early and very late, hangs up, and has not sent written verification despite your certified letters. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a call log with dates and times. A collector should identify itself and give you information about the debt, so ask again in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector demanded $3,700.00 in full for a lease debt, refused to work with your debt relief company, and spoke to you in a way that felt dismissive. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team, including how the calls were handled. Please ask the collector in writing for the validation information and keep notes of each call. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a written dispute and validation request for a $2,600.00 account, received no response, and found it reported without being marked as disputed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep proof of the date your letter was received, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies so the dispute is noted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your request for validation of a debt you dispute, including the itemization and creditor details you have asked for. We understand you want proof before taking further steps. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your letter and proof of when it was received. The basic information collectors must provide can help you check whether the debt is yours. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
